The southward path slopes down to a series of low seaside bluffs.  On the dark beach below sandpipers dart back and forth, dodging the incoming waves as they feed.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Headland Boulder]
description: A wide vista can be viewed from the top of the boulder.  To the west all of Maelstrom Bay and the great western sea spreads out before you.  To the north and east, obscure in the gloom of night, are the rolling hills of the Shattered Moors.  To the south the land dips down into darkness.  A moonlit tower rises beyond the marsh to the southeast.  Some small bones are lodged in a crevice of the boulder.

title: [Millah's Fen, Stream Bank]
description: The remnants of a cobbled stone road emerge from a wide stream and climb over the bank in the direction of a rocky hill.  The hill stands tall and alone, its rock-strewn sides covered in moss and patches of brown grass, rising out of the patchy fog, oblivious to the surrounding flat fens and marshes.  Pale, gnarled sycamores bend over the stream and surround the area with moss-draped ghostly white forms.

title: [Millah's Fen, Lookout Hill]
description: Stars fill the night sky, their light reflected faintly by a sea of fog surrounding the hilltop.  A soft glow far to the south marks the location of River's Rest and silhouettes a lone tower.  Intermittent bursts of light illuminate an omnious keep to the east, while the silence of the night air carries the sound of a distant sea to the west.  Weathered and moss covered, a stone chair is set facing the west in the center of the hilltop.

An island above the swirling fog, the top of the hill offers an endless view of the surrounding geography.  Far to the west, a blue strip represents the Great Western Sea, while to the east, an ominous stone keep emerges from the fog.  Farther to the south is a blue-roofed tower and beyond it, the minarets and towers of River's Rest.  Weathered and moss-covered, a stone chair is set facing the west in the center of the hilltop.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, East Woods]
description: Tree-dotted hillsides rise on both sides of the path, providing ample cover for the wildlife living in the woods.  The road here is mostly flat as it meanders along the city plateau, although there is a slight incline to the north.  One especially large modwir tree lies fallen near the edge of the road, its roots helplessly exposed.

title: [East Woods, Tunnel]
description: The scent of damp earth, dark and musty, fills the hole.  Broken tree roots protrude from the dirt walls and there are signs of claw marks scored deep within the packed soil.  Near the bottom of the hole is a large, rounded burrow extending deeper into the ground.

title: [Cottage Garden, Stone Building]
description: Clean wood shavings cover the floor of this one room building and several mounds of dried grass line the back wall.   The cozy scent of oak, modwir and grass wars with a faint underlying smell of goat.  An oak bucket rests next to a milking stool in one corner of the room and a watering trough and feed bin in the other.

title: [Stone Building, Attic Loft]
description: Piles of straw and dried grass completely cover the floor of the upper story of the stone building.  The exposed wooden beams and slanted roof of the barn form a low ceiling overhead.  A ladder descends down to the floor below.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A tower rises up in the center of the city.  Perched atop its massive height is an octogonal shaped building.  Wide stone steps lead up the side of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, First Level]

title: [Canyon, Gecko Ledge]
description: A faint breeze blowing up from the river adds a hint of moisture to the air, but the craggy rocks and sparse trees on the ledge are dry.  Several small lizards cling to the rock wall of the canyon, their faded brown color almost blending into the reddish stone.  A steep trail winds up the canyon wall.

title: [Canyon Ridge, Garden]
description: Hiding among the lush transplanted tropical plants and prickly cactus are a wide variety of lizards.  Multiple species of iguanas, anoles, geckos and other reptiles scurry about, basking in the sun or munching on leaves and bugs.  They seem to have little fear of the two-legged creatures visiting their home, regarding you with a total lack of care.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, up, down

title: [Canyon, Dragon's Ridge]
description: Sparse grasses and rocks cover the expanse between the red stone ridge and the steep trail that leads down the canyon wall to the west.  Several large spiny lizards wander along the top of the ridge, scurrying after bugs or reclining lazily in the sun.

title: [Hallway]
description: Lush deep red carpet stretches the length of the hall's floor, and portraits of the House's founders line the granite walls.  A small engraved plaque is hung at eye level for all to see.  Nestled in the center of the hall, an ebonwood balcony overlooks the Hall of Dreadnaught and its dominating griffin sculpture.  At the far end of the hall, a winding staircase leading to a heavy black iron door gives access to the tower, while a spiral stairway leads down to the ground floor.

title: [Watchtower]
description: Flying high at the tower's apex is a black-crested flag.  The stones ringing the tower's perch are tall enough to offer some protection from the elements and other assaults.  Spaced between the stones are slits wide enough for lookouts and archers to easily assess the surrounding ground.  Sturdy ebony barrels are strategically placed between the slits, giving easy access to arrows in times of siege.  The rotating ballista dominates the area with its ominous presence.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Sanctuary]
description: An expansive rotunda opens to form a bright, airy room, illuminated by long, narrow windows.  Tall pillars of gold-flecked white marble stretch upward toward the domed ceiling that hovers above the benches facing a carved alabaster altar and a rose quartz baptismal font.  A delightful fresco serves as a colorful backdrop in the nave.  A modwir door leads to a prayer garden and, towards the back of the rotunda, a gold-trimmed haon door leads to the oratory.  A simple maoral door leads to the priest's vestry.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Altar]
description: Set back into a shallow fresco-painted nave with wreaths of red and white Elanthian snow roses ringing the base, the altar clearly serves as the central focus of the sanctuary.

title: [Oleani's Temple, Baptism Font]
description: The tall structure sits on a slightly raised platform with steps descending into a small sunken pool.  A shallow basin set into the top is filled with warm water for blessing newborns, the run-off spilling down one side of the font in a quiet waterfall, filling the pool below.

title: [Warrior Guild, Sentry]
description: From this vantage point, an impressive view of the guild and its ample grounds can be observed.  Several courtyards, neatly outlined in crisscrossing walkways bespeak of the arduous task of maintaining such crisp surroundings.  The guild's two stories and multitude of small square windows break up the otherwise stale appearance of the dark grey stone.  A short wooden bridge over a pristine moat leads back to the city.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Warrior Guild]
description: The moat is curiously narrow under the bridge, affording a decent amount of walking and resting space.  The ground is littered with small pebbles, most pounded firmly into the sturdy, albeit moist ground, by heavy foot traffic.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Bluff Face]
description: A ring of cottonwood trees shelters quaint houses nestled beneath their boughs.  Here and there, beams of light break through the mist, shining down in stark rays which coax drops of dew to glisten.  A bluff rises from the sandy loam, its face incised with a course of steps cut into the granite in a lazy curve that offsets the steep cant.  Above, a rooftop or two can be glimpsed through the thick mantle of trees.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Lakeview Bluff]
description: The elevation of the cliff offers a panoramic view of the lake, with the mist-cloaked castle hulking at the far end and a pencil thin tower rising out of thick fog to the north.  Oaks dominate the ridge, with pine trees tucked around the feet of the taller trees with their lacy foliage of needles.  The scent emanating from cottage hearths mixes with the aroma from the pines in a fresh, spicy perfume.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Vestibule]
description: The polished mahogany of the high, arching ceilings in this chamber is a stark contrast to the alabaster stone of the reinforcing ribbed vaults.  Dangling from the center vault is a gleaming chain of silver links, suspending a softly glowing globe of crackled glass.  A silver-threaded tapestry hangs next to a spindly black willow table that is pushed against the wall.  Opposite the entry door, the area widens considerably to allow space for a dramatic staircase of silver-flecked white marble.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Great Hall]
description: The vaulted ceiling of the hall rises to a spectacular height, and the smooth stonework is punctuated by elongated oval skylights that admit slanting rays of moonlight.  Natural light combined with the candles burning amid dozens of filigree sconces set into the walls causes the ivory-veined grey marble floor to gleam.  Soft velvet curtains in various hues of blue and grey drape the northern wall and are tied back in the center to display a polished granite arch.

title: [Ravelin, River's Edge]
description: River birds dart to and fro as they search for a choice morsel dropped from the fishermen's haul.  Nets spread out drying on tall wooden structures line the bank downstream from the dock, their latticed cords impeccably mended.  The slate of the square to the northwest lines the riverbank, providing a perfect place to take in the sights of the river and a border for the grassy lawn between the bank and the rest of the gentle slope.

A black-capped night heron hunches on a piling, keeping silent sentry over the starlit surface of the stream. title: [Ravelin, Riverside Dock]
description: Thick rope supported between each wooden piling creates a railing for this small river dock.  Several wooden barrels are stacked underneath a large fish-shaped sign hanging from a weathered thanot shop.  A small wooden ladder secured to the edge of the platform leads down to a boat mooring.  Fishermen move about carrying boxes of supplies and baskets of fresh fish from the day's catch.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Atrium]
description: Pearly moonlight streams in through the glass walls and ceiling, picking pale blossoms out of the shadows formed by the lush vegetation.  The rich fragrance of tropical blooms rises in the night air, along with thin wisps of mist from the wide oval pool.  Occasionally, the chirping or clicking of a nocturnal insect adds music to the quiet setting.  Barely visible in the corner is a spiraling silver staircase, and a pair of glass double doors lead outside to the grounds.

Thriving in the direct sunlight, lush vegetation and a myriad of exotic blooms bedeck the solarium in tropical elegance.  In the center of the room is a wide oval pool.  A panoramic view of the manor grounds lies beyond the glass walls of the space, and a spiraling silver staircase is partially hidden behind a cluster of palm fronds in the corner.  Framed by an arch of ivy bearing crimson trumpet blossoms, a pair of glass double doors leads outside.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Observatory]
description: A short wrought iron railing encloses this space, which is little more than a flat tower roof.  Open to the night sky above, the expanse of the heavens appears without limit.  A polished oak table holds a few charts, which are open and held down with glass paperweights.  A long divan covered in pale blue linen provides a comfortable place to rest, and a copper-banded spyglass sits upon a silver stand, ready to observe the night sky.

Several large books sit closed upon a polished oak table next to a stack of rolled-up charts.  A long divan covered in pale blue linen provides a comfortable place to rest.

title: [Heart of the Temple]
description: Large brass pillars surround this central chamber, reaching up to the high vaulted ceiling.  Intricate mosaics decorate the floor with a complex spiraling pattern.  Numerous monks sit in quiet prayer, entranced by the thick incense floating skyward.  In the center of the room stands a raised dais supporting an intricate altar, and above you glimpse several worshippers peering down over the balcony.

title: [Temple of Jastev, High Altar]
description: The gray stone altar seems very plain in comparison to the rest of the temple.  Small offerings have been left on top to help with the daily costs and maintenance.  While all are welcome to approach the altar to show their devotion, this is probably not the proper place to dally or converse.

title: [Small Airship, Cabin]
description: A large window bordered with crimson eahnor allows an unfettered view of the surroundings on nearly all sides - the massive bow of the ship being directly in front of you.  A large pattern is inscribed upon the mute grey wood of the deck, the contours of the silver coalescing into an arcane design.  A semi-circle of comfortable velvet cushions surrounds a translucent dome set into the center of the design, its surface humming faintly with power.

title: [Small Airship, Below Deck]
description: The small winding staircase comes to an end here, revealing the luxurious, spacy room that spreads out before you.  A low-set maoral table stands in the middle of the room, its reflective surface mirroring the gentle wind-like patterns incised upon the walls.  Soft crimson carpets hide nearly all of the lustrous grey wood, their dark tones matching the curving contours of the dark velvet couch set before the table.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: White limestone mixes with the tower's dark foundation from its base to its crown and is a marked sign of renovation to the ancient premises.  Against the outer wall, a stone stairway spirals upward towards four landings and is wrapped by dark ebonwood banisters.  Above the stairway, daylight trickles across the eight crenellated points, outlining new and old stone work, some of which glints with foreign metal.

Against the outer wall, a stone stairway spirals upward, its course illuminated by bracketed torches and interrupted by four landings.  Above the stairway, the roof of the tower has been removed to expose the night sky and all eight crenellated points have been repaired.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: Glossy ebonwood banisters, lacquered and etched with mystic runes, wrap the stairwell as it climbs from the base of the tower to the highest landing.  A wide shelf juts outward from the limestone tower walls over an arch that leads to a repaired room.  Gone are the torches of yore, their scorch marks upon the smooth walls the only testament to their existence.  In their place are strange globes holding dancing lights of lime green, which flicker and sputter sporadically.

title: [Geyser Flats, Columnar Basalt]
description: The trail stops at the foot of a ridge formed of columnar basalt.  Rectangular fingers of stone reach up toward the sky like square tubes of a primitive pipe organ, their dark surfaces tinged in places with bright sienna.  Crevices in the stone make climbing the ridge possible, however easier trails lead off in other directions.

title: [Geyser Flats, Plateau]
description: Beyond the top of the bluff, another flat, stone plateau surrounds geyser holes and vivid blue pools of water.  Steam rises from some of the reservoirs, marking the location of hot springs.  The stone underfoot is stained with bright bands of color, dyed by the constant barrage of minerals carried in the clouds of condensation, drifting across the vista like an indistinct herd of ghostly behemoths.

title: [Stone Steps]
description: The steps are steep and they twist up the cliff's face in a lazy S-curve like the trail of a snake climbing a desert dune.  Along the cliff-side of the flight, knobs have been carved in the form of sand devil heads that support a rudimentary handrail crafted of teak.  The rail passes through the sand devils' bared teeth, leaving one to worry that the monsters will at some point grow tired of their burden and spit the rail out.

title: [Stone Steps]
description: At this junction of the dizzy flight of steps, the way splits.  To the northeast, the steps continue to climb toward a platform cut into the cliff wall.  This appears to be an entrance into a large dwelling perched atop the ramparts.  To the south, the steps pass over a chasm between the cliff face and a beautiful building constructed on the pillar rising from the foot of the precipice.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Gate House]
description: You are in a cylindrical chamber carved from the stone of the mountain.  Prominent in the center is a large, stone chair with an iron chest next to it. Against the east wall is a raised platform, about 20 feet high, with a wooden battlement on top.

You are in a cylindrical chamber carved from the stone of the mountain.  Prominent in the center is a large, stone chair with an iron chest next to it.  Against the east wall is a raised platform, about 20 feet high, with a wooden battlement on top.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Battlement]
description: You are on top of the battlement platform.  It seems this defensible position was actually used to protect a large, wooden wheel which juts halfway out of the east wall, rather than to cover the person sitting in the chair below.

title: [Beldrin's Game Hall, Larder]
description: This is the larder where food and drink served in the gaming hall are stored.  An open window near the ceiling reveals a patch of sky, but it is too high for you to reach from where you now stand.  Casks of wine and ale are stacked almost to the rafters, leaving you little room to maneuver.  A stairway leads down.

title: [Beldrin's Game Hall, Storeroom]
description: You are perched precariously atop a stack of casks.  You see the floor of the storeroom beneath you.  The ceiling is so close you can touch it and the open window is within your reach.

title: [Wizard Guild, Foyer]
description: Towering above the surroundings and set into an arched niche is a well-polished white marble statue of an elf in flowing robes, a pair of sweeping ivory-hued staircases circling around her.  Twin banners flutter to the left and right of the statue -- the one upon the right bearing the crest of House Illistim and the other bearing the insignia of the Wizard Guild.  Warm amber light flows from the landing at the top of the stairs, playing across the flawless balcony in shimmering waves.

title: [Wizard Guild, Chamber]
description: Crimson eahnor is worked in intricate designs upon the dark grey marble floor, the gleaming metal's surface set afire by the numerous orbs of warm amber light hovering in mid-air.  A small arched door, a dark onyx door, and a dark steel door break up the monotony of the north wall, while the southern end of the chamber leads to a spiral staircase that ascends further up into the tower's reach.

title: [Wizard Guild, Chamber]
description: Crimson eahnor is worked in intricate designs upon the dark grey marble floor, the gleaming metal's surface set afire by the numerous orbs of warm amber light hovering in mid-air. title: [Wizard Guild, Nexus of Elements]
description: The half-translucent surroundings of crystal are marked with a variety of flowing runes, their wavy forms casting four distinct hues of light across the wide, cavernous surroundings.  A single black tome sits atop a dark onyx podium, its pages rustling ever so slightly with brief drafts of air flowing in from the east.  A small marble staircase leads into the upper sections of the tower, the faint hums of power from above reverberating around the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, down

title: [Small Estate, Foyer]
description: Long, thin ivory columns encircle the room, marking the borders of a round disc of pure white marble, its surface streaked with veins of pale crimson.  A deep crimson rose serves as a central mural upon the lustrous marble, its dark petals crafted of thick stained glass.  A sweeping staircase adorned with rich velvet rugs leads further up, while hallways branch off to the east and west.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Small Estate, Landing]
description: The white marble tile is partially obscured by a round carmine rug, its curves matching the interior of the room and the slightly domed ceiling above.  A circle of ivory doors surround the area, each traced with a different trailing pattern of ebony.  A pair of stained glass doors leads out to a quaint balcony, their panes spilling a soft carmine light from beyond the threshold.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Steam]
description: The area is in a constant state of shifting haziness as whorls of stifling hot steam eddy in thick clouds and rise toward the ceiling.  The surrounding walls are slightly curved, allowing droplets of moisture to accumulate upon the wavy patterns incised upon their crystalline surfaces.  At the far end of the chamber is a swirled triple-tined vent, its interior releasing howling bursts of steam every few moments.  Identical steps lead upward into both west and east walls.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Fire]
description: The crystalline walls are melted into frozen rivulets in this chamber, and held within them are roaring flames that slither along the walls like sinuous serpents of an endless inferno.  Engulfing the entire chamber and held at bay by a small measure of translucent crystal, the heat from the fire washes across the chamber in hazy waves, blurring and contorting the air about the room.  A set of steps descends down through the center of the room's floor.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Nexus of Elements, Water]
description: Waves of pale cerulean wash over the surroundings, the walls holding currents of water that flow in twisted rivulets, the torrent held back by the translucent crystal.  Sparks of dark luminescence briefly flare to life amid the swirling streams of water, fading in and out of existence like the dark eyes of an aquatic beast.  A faint roaring sound echoes in from the west, and droplets of watery mist dance in the air.  A set of steps descends down through the center of the room's floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, down

title: [Citadel, Vault]
description: As cold as this chamber is, you'd think you were in Icemule, not Ta'Vaalor.  Stairs lead downward into the darkness.

title: [Citadel, Icehouse]
description: A single sconce illuminates the room, but it is woefully inadequate.  A row of wooden tubs is lined up against one wall, the water looking anything but comfortable.

title: [Citadel, Icehouse]
description: A single sconce illuminates the room, but it is woefully inadequate.  A row of wooden tubs is lined up against one wall, the water looking anything but comfortable.

title: [Citadel, Darkroom]
description: There is but a single candle burning, and all it reveals is a room no larger than a closet.  A shelf holds several clear glass bottles, odd shapes writhing and twisting within them.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entrance Hall]
description: A light sifting of dust covers the terra cotta floor, apparently tracked in from the courtyard beyond the double doors.  Lanterns hung from sconces along the whitewashed walls protect the candles within from the cool night breeze which moves through the unglazed windows.  Corridors lead off to the east and west, their beamed ceilings only slightly higher than a tall giantman's head.

title: [Warrior Guild, Second Floor]
description: Windows lining every wall of the expansive upper story provide ample light and a good view of the guild's grounds.  The view is the only feature of note, as the room is bare of furniture or decoration.

title: [Cleric Guild, River's Rest]
description: Onyx columns gleam in the light of myriad beeswax tapers which surround two central statues.  Each of the figures is cut from pale stone, as is the inscribed base on which they stand.  There are no windows, but the high arc of the domed ceiling keeps the chamber from feeling too enclosed.  An aged oak door is set between two onyx columns, and deep blue carpets, their patterns almost obscured by constellations of jasmine petals, muffle the steps of passing priests.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cleric Guild, Aviary]
description: Gilded mesh encloses a piece of the sky, and you are surrounded by birdsong. Parrots flash their brilliant colors amidst the branches of potted trees, the birds' cries a raucous counterpoint to the trilling of plainer, but more eloquent larks.  The aviary's wire walls permit smaller birds to come and go, but even the fenvaoks seem content with their eyrie above the guild.

Gilded mesh encloses a piece of the night sky, and you are lulled by soporific birdsong.  Owls continue their low-pitched inquiry of the nightingales who sing amidst the branches of the potted trees, but the raucous parrots and fenvaoks are asleep.  The moons seem nearer and worldly matters much more distant from this eyrie.

title: [Rogue Guild, East Courtyard]
description: The wood and stone back walls of the surrounding buildings form a spacious, elongated courtyard that extends to the west through the middle of the block.  Most of the snow has been cleared away by the constant passing of trampling feet, and a few hardy evergreen vines add spots of green to the grey and brown of the frosty walls.

title: [Icemule Trace, Rooftop]
description: The nondescript rooftop is covered by a blanket of snow broken only by the quickly fading outlines of several sets of footprints leading off to the north.  An old ladder propped against the back of the building leads down into a narrow courtyard.

title: [Wizard Guild, Observatory]
description: Most of the spacious chamber is taken up by a massive brass orrery, the various moons and planets crafted from enamelled metal.  A silver telescope is pointed upwards towards the heavens, its surface holding a pristine shine.  Detailed and precise paintings of the constellations adorn the walls.  A large fissure in the stone ceiling provides the telescope an unobstructed view of the heavens.  Steps descend into a very narrow cleft cut in the rock.

title: [Wizard Guild, Steps]
description: The narrow channel feels as enclosed as a chimney and is almost as sooty.  The rock walls around you are uncomfortably warm to the touch, and the widely spaced torches shed little light on the seemingly never-ending steps.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Lost in the Fog]
description: You are in a dense fog bank and can see absolutely nothing.  You  realize that you can probably back out of here easily enough.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, The Summit]
description: You emerge onto a stone landing which looks like an island in a sea of cloud.  Somehow it is suddenly night, and the sky above is sparkling with thousands of tiny stars.  The Great Moon Liabo hangs silently in the sky, its surface shrouded by the clouds of its atmosphere.  A tiny black point against this backdrop, Tilaok, can be seen in its orbit around Liabo.  A large opening leads into the mountain at this height.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alchemy Nexus]
description: Wind whips through the open air stone room, the scent of the sea thick in the air and accompanied by the sound of crashing waves.  Five platforms extend from the immediate area and beyond them in all directions lies an endless expanse of dark water.  A glimpse over the edge of the platform reveals its location atop a great stone tower anchored in the sea, hundreds of feet above the surface of the water.  In the center of the platform stands a pillar, behind which descends a staircase.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storage]
description: Far cooler than the outdoor platforms above, the room is dimly lit by two feeble candles placed on two large wooden stands opposite each other by opposing walls.  Much of the wall space is covered in large wooden shelves and a series of cabinets replete with many small wooden drawers.  A few inches of dust cover much of everything, including the floor, revealing a number of tiny clawed footprints.

title: [Spitfire, Cargo Hold]
description: A large stack of crates, boxes and barrels blocks further progress, forcing the aisle to turn back upon itself.  From one of the larger barrels sitting to the side, a small flicker of light peeks out from cracks marring its wooden slats.

title: [The Cold Hold]
description: A layer of thin fresh ice covers the uneven walls and narrow floor in this small hold.  Hoarfrost glistens with a myriad of colorful reflections cast by the flickering flames of an oil lamp that dangles precariously overhead from a rusty length of chain.  The thick chain weaves along the ceiling, anchored in place with large wooden pegs, and supports the frozen carcass of a sizeable sea thrak.  Crooked stairs lead up and out, an icy wooden handrail the only aid in successfully navigating them.

title: [Albatross, Cashier]
description: White alabaster and dark mahogany flooring are cleverly conjoined into the image of a giant roulette wheel.  Heavy tapestries hang from the walls, each depicting gamblers winning at different games.  Some shallow steps lead down into the roulette pit that are position between a gold-trimmed rosewood door and an expansive mahogany archway.

title: [Albatross, Roulette Pit]
description: Richly paneled walls and lush crimson carpeting are illuminated by myriad candles behind hunter green glass, but the focal point of this pit is the elaborate roulette wheel on a polished mahogany table.  The numbers chart, betting sign, and rules poster are all framed in gold and hang from the rosewood walls in easy view of all gamblers.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Lobby]
description: Sconces line the walls of the rectangular, granite-floored room, each set upon a narrow marble column that reaches up and supports a high ceiling.  A large torn banner is draped down one wall and set behind a simple black marble altar placed in the center of the room.  Five narrow archways, draped with dark red velvet curtains, lead off from the chamber into adjacent rooms.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Storage]
description: The circular chamber is built of dark granite with the exception of white marble used to outline the ribbing of a vaulted ceiling.  The room is mainly bare with only a few stacked crates flanked on one side by a large dust bin and on the other by a wooden footlocker.  An archway, outlined with the same marble as the ceiling, leads off into another room.

title: [After Thoughts, Amidships]
description: Moonlight trickles in from outside to provide a small measure of visibility.  A corroded copper ladder is revealed, recessed in the lone interior wall.  Beside the ladder, a deteriorated black ash door leads towards the bow.  The exterior walls are badly weathered, and the copper-framed windows set within them have not held glass in ages.  Flexing precariously underfoot, a wooden deck creaks and groans with each step.

Sunlight pours in through five large glassless, copper-framed windows set within the boat's badly weathered exterior walls.  A corroded copper ladder is recessed in the lone interior wall, leading up.  Beside the ladder, a deteriorated black ash door leads towards the bow.  The wooden deck creaks and flexes precariously underfoot.

title: [After Thoughts, Pilot Deck]
description: A section of the floor has fallen away, forming a ramp leading down to the main deck.  The hammered copper roof of the cabin is pitted and riddled with holes, supported by four massive pillars of weathered black ash.  The ship's wheel is almost nonexistant, just a remnant hub with fragments of what used to be the spokes

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Tall tufts of drying grasses tickle the deeply furrowed, grey bark at the base of a stately black gum.  The vibrant, purple leaves of the gum confirm the autumnal grip on the land.  Cheery music and the smells of frying food drift in on the occasional breeze from nearby.  Several colorful wagons, each painted with various deformed animals, create a semicircle around the gum.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Treehouse]
description: Painted panels of leftover planks of wood have been nailed together to form the floor of this cramped treehouse.  Draping canvas overhead provides some shelter from the elements.

title: [Abandoned Tavern, Taproom]
description: Cobwebs hang from the water-damaged ceiling of the tavern, which has partially collapsed.  Puddles of filthy water and mud are scattered across the floorboards, each brimming with life that floats upon their surface.  The bartop is covered in several layers of dust, with the abandoned bottles of alcohol barely visible underneath it.

title: [Abandoned Tavern, Cellar]
description: Half of the cellar has sank into the Feywrot Mire, with the majority of the dank room flooded with muck and water.  A foul smell is heavy in the air.  Upon the areas that are still traversable, a stacked pile of old casks dominates the cellar.

title: [Abandoned Stronghold, Rotunda]
description: The stone structure, perhaps once serving as a military garrison, has been claimed mostly by the Feywrot Mire.  Old stairwells leading below are completely filled with swamp water and muck, offering no chance to explore the depths of the fortification, but a pitted iron ladder hangs from the ceiling leading up.  A rusted iron armor stand rests in the center of the room, with weapon racks surrounding it upon each wall.  Seemingly out of place, a corroded iron footlocker is pushed up against some rubble near the exit.

A rusted armor stand has been knocked over, and several weapon racks have been picked clean of inventory.  Shards of iron litter the floor throughout the stronghold.

title: [Abandoned Stronghold, Turret]
description: The top of the stronghold is no more than a crumbling crenallation, a shadow of its former glory.  Overlooking the Feywrot Mire, the view isn't as spectacular as it could be, given the overgrowth of the swamp blocking much of the scenery.  Several dog-faced gargoyles are perched on the turret, as if they were mounted to protect the stronghold.

title: [Dreadnaught Alliance Courtyard]
description: Secured by a massive stone wall, this spacious courtyard is a welcome retreat.  A deep fire pit encircled by black stones fills the area with warmth.  An old, dried-up cobblestone well sits alongside a stone bench.  Posted near the gigantic drawbridge is an oak signpost staked into the ground.  A massive gnarled oak tree with grey threadlike moss hanging from its branches rests in the midst.  A winding cobblestone path guides travelers to the torch-lit stairs, the entrance to the Dreadnaught tavern, and beyond.

title: [Temple of Reunification]
description: This pure golden ora-plated temple holds eight glorious tapestries bearing the crests of the Great Elven Houses.  The centerpiece of the room is a slender mithril case securing an ancient elven crown atop a gold pillow, which is encircled by carving on the floor below that reads, "For The Day Eight Houses Become One."  In front of the open window overlooking the Elven Empire, a white stone table surrounded by eight seats has been masterfully hand-crafted and polished to a reflective sheen.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Foyer]
description: Black obsidian walls, polished to a sheen that nearly matches that of the tall silver mirror that stands at the west end of the foyer, rise to the vaulted ceiling thirty feet above.  A gracefully curved staircase of black marble winds along the walls, leading upwards into the higher reaches of the tower.  Dark banners emblazoned with symbols of the Dhe'nari castes hang high on the walls, and a set of double doors carved of black ora opens to the south.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
description: The open staircase hugs the wall, providing a dizzying view up into the heights of the tower.  The stair stops at a small landing at which several doors are set into the stone wall, then continues up in a steep spiral.  The glossy obsidian steps are each set with a slightly raised rolaren symbol that provides a safe grip on the slick stairs.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Hillside Path]
description: A thick forest of brown and green bamboo obscures everything but a narrow, graveled path.  Large leaves, half-trampled and rotting, litter the path.  Amid the swaying foliage, the air is scented lightly with salt and an undertone of something wet.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Canopy Approach]
description: The onset of the jungle wilderness is sudden, making the nearby existence of civilization seem a fantastical concept.  Green dominates the entirety of the rainforest setting, with a thick leaf canopy formed by the verdant growth of tall trees filtering any light into that color as well.  The drone of insects provides a subtle natural music, low and buzzing.  In the distance a haze of fog nearly obscures the view of the coast.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan Base]
description: Clusters of bright fungus dot the soft ground surrounding an enormous banyan.  The huge lattice-work trunk creates numerous hollows and nooks.  Sparse clumps of vegetation creep about the base of the tree in a feeble attempt to thrive.  To the north, a group of lichen covered boulders rise from the earth in a pyramid-like shape.

paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, northwest

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: The winding, lattice-work pattern of the bark makes for easy climbing, providing several nooks comfortable for sitting.  Twisted tree-roots hang down from the branches above, creating a skeletal canopy.  A light mist swirls down from the thick, leafy roof.

title: [Silvergate, Hallway]
description: Muffled footsteps and voices from the floor above filter through an air grille high on the end wall and echo in this wide hallway.  It is sparsely furnished, boasting only a wooden bench set opposite a tanned leather curtain which rustles in a draft.  A sturdy iron-reinforced door bars your way to the north.

title: [Silvergate, A Small Landing]
description: Muffled voices from the lounge barely reach your ears here.  Dimly lit, there is still enough light for you to make your way.  A narrow staircase leads down to the lower levels of the manor.

title: [House Phoenix, Observatory]
description: Here on the highest level of the building, most of the walls and the roof seem to be formed of a clear glasslike crystal that allows an almost unrestricted view of the sky above and the surrounding townscape.  Various instruments of observation and study stand on a raised platform in the middle of the room.  To the south is a hallway.

title: [House Phoenix, Platform]
description: From this platform, you gain a magnificent view through the windows and skylight.  The town can be studied easily in relative comfort from this high vantage point.  The sun streaming in warms and relaxes those sitting beneath the skylight.

title: [Talador Mines, Dark Tunnel]
description: Darkness only faintly peels away as parts of the tunnel are illuminated by the presence of strange glowing white maggots crawling along the walls.  At the end of the tunnel, a stony ledge rises up.

title: [Talador Mines, Stone Ledge]
description: The stone ledge rises up about the darkness of the tunnel below, opening up into a wider chamber of blackness.  No light exists, save for the eerie pale glow from the slimy worms snaking up and down the cavern walls.  Out across the ledge and the open pit of shadows, another narrow ledge is visible.

title: [Bard Guild, Entry Hall]
description: Just beyond a heavy wooden door leading back out onto the street lurks a warm, if not exceptionally spacious hallway with walls and ceiling of raw timber graced here and there by golden musical notes.  Several oil lamps hang from the beams, providing small pools of golden illumination leading to a little shop occupying a nook in the western wall.  The sounds of music drift upward from the darkened depths of a broad curving staircase, occasionally punctuated by bursts of laughter.

Snow is packed tightly between thick wooden support beams, creating a cocoon of warmth inside the snowdrift.  Several oil lamps hang from the beams, providing small pools of golden illumination on the packed snowy floor.  The sounds of music drift upward from the darkened depths of a broad curving staircase, occasionally punctuated by bursts of laughter.

title: [Bard Guild, Landing]
description: The narrow staircase pauses at a landing where the stairs crook around a curve.  To the northeast, an arch takes the place of the carved panels decorating the other walls.  A pair of bas-relief masks hangs on the lintel of the arch, one with an exaggerated grin and the other a tragic grimace.

title: [Abandoned General Store, Closet]
description: The small, cramped room reeks of death and decay.  The skeletal remains of someone or something lie in a heap on the floor -- the right hand of the deceased is missing.  A number of iron shelves line the northern wall underneath a hole in the ceiling.  Leading to the storefront is a door, the frame of which is deeply scratched.

title: [Abandoned General Store, Attic]
description: The upper level of the store is hot and humid, with some daylight peeking through holes in the roof, but not enough to offer much ventilation.  Rafters are the only way to traverse the area, which isn't very spacious.

title: [Gairen, Garden]
description: Completely secluded from the activity of the adjacent Lysierian Hills, peace and tranquility have made this robust and thriving garden their home.  Sectioned off into three quadrants, a colorful bed of fruit, vegetables, and flowers, blooms healthily and appears capable of sustaining a well-sized community.  Squat wooden benches rest beneath a magnificent weeping willow tree, the elegant curtains of drooped branches offering shade from the open sky above.

title: [Gairen, Treetop Perch]
description: Glancing outward, the expansive view of Lysierian Hills and Lake Marliese is breathtaking, the area quiet save for the rustling of branches and the occasional chirp of a cricket far off in the distance.  Scattered across the bluish black sky are twinkling constellations, creating slow moving patterns high above the shadowed floor below.  A small wooden perch has been nestled between a few of the sturdier branches, providing the perfect table for a remote, but intimate picnic.

title: [White Haven, Greenhouse]
description: Roses of every color bloom beneath a crystal dome, forming an elegant border for the rows of herbs being tended by a halfling gardener.  Lilies, jasmine and lavender create an ordered riot of pastel around a circular stone path.  In the center of the path stands a bubbling font of pristine melt-water, its quiet sound a peaceful counterpoint to the garden's stillness.

Roses of every color bloom beneath a crystal dome, forming an elegant border for long rows of winterberries being tended by a halfling gardener.  Lilies, jasmine and lavender create an ordered riot of pastel hues around a circular stone path dotted with several white-washed wrought iron tables and matching cushion-padded chairs.  In the center of the path stands a bubbling font of pristine melt-water, its quiet sound a peaceful counterpoint to the garden's stillness.

title: [White Haven, Hot Springs]
description: Warm steam from a sapphire blue pool fills the room.  The cold from outside is blotted from memory as the radiant warmth begins to sink into your bones.  About the pool are lush plants, more suited to a tropical environment, that seem to thrive upon the warmth.  Lily pads float on the surface of the bubbling pool.

Slightly raised flooring of blackened cedar drops down to gemstone mosaic tile surrounding a bubbling pool.  Misty steam fills the air, the radiant warmth sinking into your bones.  Some low, rounded cedar ottomans cluster around a small stone-bordered pond, the lush vibrancy of potted sirenflowers offset by the pale water lilies floating on the pond's surface.

title: [Twilight Tower, Observatory]
description: The long circular stairwell leads to a large sitting room with a polished red stone floor shot with white jagged streaks.  A lacquered cherrywood bar is in the center of the room surrounded by plush white velvet benches, while similar coral red benches lining the edge of the room provide comfortable observation of the sprawling scenery out the large glaes windows.

title: [Twilight Tower, Subterranean]
description: At the lower landing of the longer of the tower's two intertwined spiraling stairwells is a large underground chamber.  Two sides of the chamber are composed of bedrock, while a glaes dome encloses the area from the remaining expansive cavern and the intense river of magma flowing nearby.  Light shimmers through the dome and reflects off of massive minerals embedded in the cavern walls.  A reflective black basalt altar joins the wall beneath some ancient runes, across from the stair and next to a stalagmite.

title: [Dragonspine, Mountainside]
description: A wide precipice on the side of a towering mountain is buffetted by howling gusts of wind and clouds of snow.  Hidden partially behind a large boulder are the top rungs of a sturdy iron ladder.

title: [A Narrow Shaft, Ladder]
description: A few snowflakes dance through the air near the top of the ladder, and the freezing wind howls mercilessly.

title: [A Twisting Tunnel, Shaft]
description: The curving of the tunnel walls stops suddenly in this tiny space that is flooded with light.  Far above, an opening can be seen that reveals a tiny round patch of sky.  A sturdy iron ladder, bolted into the cave walls, leads up.

title: [A Narrow Shaft, Ladder]
description: The smooth walls of this shaft are slick with ice, and the temperature is almost unbearably cold.  Wind howls down from the opening through the shaft, shaking the ladder slightly.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs are very slippery.  A dull light shines from the top of the staircase.

title: [A Dark Cave]
description: The staircase ends abruptly in a large, round room that is freezing cold.  Torches clamped to the walls burn with odd blue flames, highlighting rusty shackles that are attached to the rough walls.  One set of shackles still holds a pitiful skeleton covered in scraps of tattered cloth.  A pointed archway in the wall leads out.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs underfoot are very slippery.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs are very slippery.  A dull light shines from the top of the staircase.

title: [A Dark Tunnel]
description: A crumbling torch, affixed to the wall with iron clamps and burning with a strange white flame, illuminates the initial steps of a very steep staircase, unevenly cut from the rough stone of the tunnel.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs underfoot are very slippery.

title: [Pi-Rate Customers]
description: Thick planks line the walls, each intersection bolted with steel plates.  The end of the shop comes to a narrow point, a single blackened window in the center of it.  The bulkhead is lined with numerous sailing navigation wheels that are connected to ropes and pullies overhead.  A large rusted anchor is suspended in the center of the room, held aloft by the turnbuckles attached to the ropes.  A wooden hatch is propped open in the center of the room, with a sloppily painted skull and cross bone design.

title: [Pi-Rate Customers]
description: The room is dark except for a single burning lantern held aloft by a thick rope.  Nestled into the far side of the room and attached to each side of the bulkhead is a sailcloth hammock.  A large cast iron bucket sits in the center of the room, filled to the brim with carved wooden ducks.  There is a single iron hook hanging above the bucket, with a few pieces of clothing on it.

title: [Bathhouse, Caldarium]
description: Lined with tiny glass chips, their patterns on the floor create a bright mosaic whose colors sharply contrast the dark wooden walls.  A rounded stone basin stands to one side of a laquered oak door, its warm water glistening in the deep recess.  A large heated pool ripples along the length of the room, beautiful azure tiles coloring the bottom.  A crimson curtained arch leads out of the room, while three white stone stairs descends into an azure-tiled pool.

title: [Caldarium, Pool]
description: Deep azure tiles line the floor and walls of the recessed pool creating a pattern that fans out from darkest to lightest.  The heated water coupled with the warm air caresses the skin, soothing the sorest of muscles.  Three white stone stairs lead up to the room above.

title: [Bathhouse, Frigidarium]
description: Tall glass windows allow sunlight to slip in through the thick foliage outside.  Stone steps lead down into a small pool, large enough for swimming.  An indigo curtained arch keeps the chilled air inside the room, cooling the water, while a polished oak door stands partially closed for the same reason.

title: [Frigidarium, Pool]
description: Chilled water fills the deep stone pool that fits into the length of the room.  Large enough to swim laps, the pool adds cool refreshment to the other workouts available in the guild.  Two stone pillars carved into a pair of swords mark the steps leading back up.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Foyer]
description: Branching in either direction, the long stone corridor arches outward in a slow curve about the area that is visible up a set of stone steps, a large steel suit of armor standing to either side.  Carved into the stone overhead is the word, "DUSKRUIN".  Another smaller dark passageway angles downward toward the bowels of the arena.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Duskruin Arena, Southern Arc]
description: Hot, bright fires burn in iron iron baskets that have been mounted in regular intervals high on the walls of this large cavern.  Centered in the subterrane is a circular arena with a sand-covered floor.  The air carries the lingering scent of the oil used to keep the dust at a minimum.  Sloping rows of stone benches surround the floor in twelve sections, each allowing for a different spectator view.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Entrance]
description: Leading up into the arena stands, a set of stone steps have shattered with long cracks splintering off into the walls and nearby floor with sand poured into the cracks, leaving the steps uneven.  A crimson banner hangs overhead emblazoned with a gold fringe and bold lettering.

description: A pair of oversized greatswords hang above a set of stone steps, leading up into the arena seating, the corridor lined with iron sconces that provide flickering light.  Other weapons of a wide variety are mounted to the back wall, serving as ominous decor.

title: [Baile Dragan, Triskelion Hall]
description: This large, open room is filled with successively higher rows of polished ebonwood benches, supported at each end by heavy, dragon-shaped legs of cast silver.  The walls are hung with magnificent tapestries worked in silver thread on a black background.  Each life-sized panel depicts a scene of a mortal and a dragon in some sort of interaction.  At the front of the room is a large dais, behind which the Ord an Dragan standard is displayed.

title: [Baile Dragan, Library]
description: The air in this dimly lit room carries the scent of parchment and leather.  Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves are packed tightly with thick tomes and parchment scrolls.  The most valuable volumes are located on a rack above a long study table, each fastened securely to a rod with a length of chain.  Oil lamps burn brightly on several reading desks equipped with inkwells and quill pens.  Two comfortable chairs and an overstuffed leather sofa create a cozy reading nook for more casual study sessions.

title: [Baile Dragan, The Wyrm's Rest]
description: Hazy with smoke from the wood fire and redolent of ale and other spirits, this spacious room is a gathering place for local residents.  In the center of the room, a fireplace with an immense circular hearth provides wanted warmth in winter and a cook-fire year round.  Tables and benches run the length of the room on opposing sides of the fireplace, with more at either end, and the floor is strewn with fresh rushes.  Bundles of fragrant herbs and bottles of brew line the shelves behind the serving counter

title: [Baile Dragan, Cellar]
description: A cool temperature makes the cellar at Baile Dragan an ideal storage area.  The room is filled with kegs of ale and cider and racks of bottled wines, some labeled with the finer vintages of decades past.  Neatly stored in the room are sacks of potatoes and root vegetables, armor and weapons, and other sundry goods necessary for the running of such an establishment.  A small niche is outfitted with a wooden table, a wash tub, and an iron brazier.

title: [Necropolis, Descent]
description: An old iron lantern hangs over a giant pile of rubble from a recent cave-in.  A steep ramp leading up is covered in encrusted gore, likely used to dump the dead that had no place in the necropolis.

title: [Necropolis, Crossing]
description: Two large statues stand guard over the northern entrance into the necropolis, facing the remains of a stone bridge that overlooks a vast abyss of darkness.  Each statue holds a rusted iron pike, which cross over each other like an archway.

title: [The Brazen Bull]
description: An oppressive heat fills the room, bearing down on everything within the walls even as it rises from a rectangular grate in the center of the floor.  Over the grate hangs a series of rusted iron hooks, upon which the shop's wares are displayed.  A large brass-framed painting has been mounted on the wall opposite the door.

title: [The Brazen Bull]
description: A long metal table is the only piece of furniture in this sparsely decorated room.  A sharp and rusty lever has been mounted to its side.  Situated low on one wall is a dented metal hatch, the floor surrounding it dusty with iron shavings.  A large brass-framed painting hangs just above the hatch.

title: [Ranger Guild, Yard]
description: Ice sculptures carved into the shapes of local wildlife decorate the yard, nestled between small evergreen shrubs that line the area.  Tall cedars and other evergreens beyond the shrubs block the wind from the wide-open clearing.

title: [Ranger Guild, Pine Treehouse]
description: The dense branches of the pine shelter the treehouse from the relentless frigid winds.   The very sturdy platform has been crafted out of oak, the railings around it serving as backrests for those who choose to sit.  Gaps in the branches offer an excellent view of the guild's yard below.

title: [Underground Temple, Core]
description: Leaning precariously to one side, a massive stone altar dominates the southern end of the temple.  Webs of cracks and crevices mar the stone beneath and render ancient floor carvings nearly indiscernible.  Partially concealed by the altar, a small tunnel leads down into darkness.

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: A musty odor fills the area, a combination of the moist dirt that forms the walls and floors, and decaying bits of worm and rodent packed within.  Bits of bone and stone randomly litter the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up, down

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: Dangling from a perch constructed at the tree opening above your head is a thick knotted rope.  Since the wooden pegs inside the tree have all but disappeared, this appears to be the only way to continue upwards.

title: [Oak Tree, Wooden Perch]
description: This well-constructed perch has been situated half inside the tree and half outside.  An ornate carved railing surrounds the edge in a half-moon shape, providing protection from falling.  From this height, the ground is not visible at all.  All you can see is green leaves and branches to all sides.  Off to one side of the perch is a sturdy oak ladder leading up to another platform.

title: [Oak Tree, Wooden Platform]
description: Built around the entire trunk of the tree, this platform is massive in size.  A wooden railing carved with an intricate knotwork design surrounds the entire platform.  A vibrant bluebird flies by, landing in a nest filled with babies begging for food.  Up above, the cloud-filled sky is finally starting to become visible.

title: [Oak Tree, Top of the Tree]
description: Atop this gigantic tree, an oak platform has been constructed.  A colorful array of flower petals is scattered over the floor, occasionally whirling about the air whenever a gust of wind rushes through the tree top.  Spread about the platform are several benches, providing ideal locations for contemplation and reflection.  Near each bench is a handcrafted wicker basket filled to the brim with petals.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: The cobblestone pavers underfoot are a shade of charcoal, blackened from fire that swept through the courtyard, scorching the earth and rocks.  Carved from a solid mass of stone, a dark passageway leads down into an underground dungeon.  Mounted on either side of the cavernous opening is a pair of glaes-paned lanterns.  An open wooden crate filled with supplies sits near the entrance.

title: [Reim Settlement, Dungeon]
description: A single, narrow hole is carved directly overhead, casting a spotlight into the center of the dungeon.  Water trickles down the moss-covered stone walls, the drops echoing loudly amidst the sounds of strange clicking, hissing, and screams.  The stairwell narrows as it continues down, deeper into the dungeon.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: Stone walls tower above the path leading up to a long stone stairway.  A carved ironwood planter box filled with freshly tilled soil sits by the stairway with a variety of oak-handled garden tools discarded beside it.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: Alternating in height, the stone walls of the barbican are carved with narrow slits set in equal distances apart.  Neatly piled next to each wall opening is a pile of bolts and arrows with thick, green fluid dried to the tips.

title: [Bard Guild, Landing]
description: The landing is a convergence of two flights of stairs, where the turn of the steps has been enlarged to accommodate a large palm and a teak bench.  From a terra cotta urn standing in one corner comes the peaceful sound of bubbling water.  An arch occupies the east wall, through which one can see the upward slope of an elevated walkway.

title: [Bard Guild, Winding Stairwell]
description: The curving stairwell widens at the foot of a window, its view partially obstructed by heavily carved wooden screens.  Beyond the screens lies a panoramic vista of quaint rooftops and minarets, and in the distance, the sparkle of moonlight on water.  An arched doorway is discretely set in a small alcove produced by the stairway's turn, and from inside, the clink of glass and delicious aromas extend an invitation to come within.

title: [Bard Guild, Fest Hall]
description: The Bard Guild Fest Hall is an expansive chamber, tiled with dark grey stone beneath the dark teak paneling of the walls.  Overhead, the ceiling is high, allowing mid-day heat to rise above the chamber's inhabitants, and giving headroom to the double rows of massive palms potted in likewise monumental urns.  Teak tables and comfortable-looking black leather armchairs provide a minimal, and strikingly elegant, tableau.

title: [Bard Guild, Entryway]
description: Halos of light shine from a sconce hanging overhead with ruby red glass enclosing its light source.  The entry is shadowed, its high ceiling lost in gloom and surrounded by dark wood walls with heavily carved bas-relief surfaces.  A stairway leads down with barely enough light to illuminate the carpeted stairs and curved wooden banister, and from below, strains of music drift up in disjointed fragments, like spirits climbing out of the depths.

title: [Bard Guild, Fest Hall]
description: The expansive hall is a beamed chamber with paneled walls, their polished wood peeking out from behind a wealth of tapestries hanging on all sides.  Groupings of chairs and stools sit in an array, overshadowed by a large, circular sofa occupying the room's center.  An imposing carved marble bust overlooks all, perched on the pedestal created by the plush sofa's crimson velvet back-cushions.

title: [Anemone Villa, Meeting Hall]
description: Polished teak floors gleam beneath a delicate patina of lacquer and reflect the golden sunlight that filters in through the room's linen-framed windows.  Positioned beneath an elaborate chandelier, a violet rug supports a claw-foot low mahogany table surrounded by armchairs and loveseats.  Occupying the eastern wall, a marble-mantled fireplace is surrounded by a whitewashed haon door on one side and a linden-edged white door on the other.

title: [Anemone Villa, Master Bedroom]
description: Vaulted ceilings decorated with swathes of painted silk are arranged to give the impression that the room opens to the sky.  Tropical plants, housed in enormous urns, give the space a natural feel that is reflected in the warm linens that cover the carved golden linden bed.  Candles housed within bird-shaped vessels provide ample illumination from their perch upon the decorative armoires and dressing tables.  Glass-paned doors in the southern wall stand open to the sunlit balcony.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Great Hall]
description: The threshold of the tower leads into a circular room with a spiraling stone staircase as its centerpiece.  Behind an iron railing that follows the circumference of the chamber, the interior wall is lined from floor to ceiling with bookshelves, broken only by an arched heavy wooden door.  Tall iron candelabras form a semi-circle around the stairs, their candles filling the area with a warm glow.

title: [Sylinar's Spire]
description: The walls of the second level are bare, save for a few sconces and the open door that stands amidst its white stones.  The staircase spirals further upward to the third level of the tower.

title: [Sylinar's Spire]
description: A plum velvet curtain covers a third of the curved wall, while recessed shelving has been built along its remainder.  The staircase spirals further upward to the fourth level of the tower.

title: [Sylinar's Spire]
description: A white tallow candle drips in its holder atop a small writing desk.  The stool in front of it is covered with a thick layer of dust.  Several small nicks mar the frame of the door opposite the desk.  The staircase spirals further upward to the fifth level of the tower.

description: An arched wooden door stands illuminated by tall pillar candles sitting on stone pedestals to either side.  The staircase has been blocked by a thick-linked iron chain, preventing further ascent.

title: [Sylvanfair, Summoning Chamber]
description: Nestled deep below the trunk of the great tree, this extraordinary chamber exudes a tangible sense of living energy.  Enormous, gnarled roots hold back the sooty earth, glowing eerily with sparse pockets of phosphorescent lichen.  Shadowy nooks and crannies disappear between the roots into inky blackness, hinting at unseen secrets.  Intricate arcane runes have been painstakingly etched upon nearly every exposed surface of the chamber.

title: [Sylvanfair, Secret Passageway]
description: A roughly excavated tunnel ends here at the back of a heavy wooden bookcase.  Thick, tangled roots crisscross the earthen passageway as it spirals down into darkness.

title: [Underground Temple, Core]
description: Leaning precariously to one side, a massive stone altar dominates the southern end of the temple.  Webs of cracks and crevices mar the stone beneath and render ancient floor carvings nearly indiscernible.  Partially concealed by the altar, a small tunnel leads down into darkness.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, northwest, down

title: [Underground Temple, Sunken Tomb]
description: A musty odor fills the area, a combination of the moist dirt that forms the walls and floors, and decaying bits of worm and rodent packed within.  Bits of bone and stone randomly litter the floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up, down

title: [Reim Fortress, North Gate]
description: Iron-caged torches flank the gate and are sheltered from the screaming winds by the high granite walls.  Large oak beams, charred and scarred from past battles, have been pushed against the eastern wall to create a long ramp that leads to some of the fortress's remaining rooms.  An odd series of stones imbedded into the wall disappear from sight as they climb the wall.

title: [Reim Fortress, Supply Room]
[Reim Fortress, Supply Closet]
description: Splintered wooden barrels containing a variety of broken weapons lie on their sides near the ramp that leads back to the main level.  A pile of dented mithril breastplates has been heaped into a corner beneath thick iron hooks where ripped and bloodstained robes hang lifelessly.

description: Whipping winds rush through the crenellation that tops the walls on the northern edge of the platform, while the southern edge looks down upon the ravaged and roofless remains of a long corridor.  A fitfully burning fire, its flames casting about from the ever-changing directions of the air, is barely contained by a stone box that helps support the bubbling iron cauldron that rests upon it.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Aft Deck]
description: Most of this expansive deck is navigable, save a large cypress mast mid-deck and its accompanying lanyards and mast stays.  A brass railing encircling the main deck of the vessel provides sufficient viewing space for those wishing to gaze out upon the waters.  A decorative, nautical motif is inlaid along the edges of the smooth teak planking underfoot.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Aftcastle]
description: Fanciful carvings decorate the edge planking around this raised portion of the upper deck at the stern of the sailing vessel.  Brass handrails aid passengers and crew alike when the sea swells exacerbate or the winds turn to gales.  One large cabin for the captain, and some smaller quarters for his mate, keep both in close proximity to the helm where a large ship's wheel is mounted firmly on the aftcastle decking.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Fore Deck]
description: A line of blanket-draped, polished mahogany deck chairs await guests along the railing, some turned inward to facilitate conversation with fellow passengers, others turned outward, providing a view of the vast expanse of open seas.  Waves lapping against the hull of the large vessel provide a rhythmic accompaniment to the whistle of nightime winds through the sails and the muted chatter of ship-bound guests.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Forecastle]
description: Perched high above the main decking, the view offered from the polished brass railings of the forecastle stretches off many leagues toward the horizon. To each side of the spacious decking, a set of coral-dusted stairs descends further into the vessel's depths.

title: [Caligos Isle, Dockside Stairway]
description: Climbing the perpetually slick stairway demands attention and care, as the fall from this height would surely end badly on the jagged, black rocks below.  A dusting of ground black coral, lacquer-sealed across each board, gives at least some purchase underfoot.  Swirling mists and thick, grey fog make ascertaining safe footing difficult, even with bright and colorful lanterns swinging wildly overhead in the fierce winds coming off the nighttime sea.

Narrow, broken stone pathways to the east and west lead off toward the rest of the island.

title: [Caligos Isle, Junder's Midway]
description: Brisk winds coil around the basalt outcropping like a serpent around its prey, threatening to deplete the available air in an instant.  Thick fog sodden with sea spray veils the view, though the sound of immense waves crashing against the rocks below is good indication to hang on tightly to the ladder rungs.  Peeking through occasional breaks in the mist-laden cloud is a sloped ledge, though what lies beyond is not visible.

title: [Caligos Isle, Junder's Peak]
description: Bursting through a heavy blanket of mist and fog, the island's landscape emerges, a rare sight from one of the few outlook points on the island.  Deep indigo waters ring the island and lead to a vast sea beyond, with no landmarks or distant coastlines to guide travel.  Despite a thin middle section, a large platform lies at the top of this naturally formed tower, its trunk possibly diminished by unforgiving winds.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cliff Trail]
description: A stagnant pool sits beneath a rocky overhang covered in a sickly orange-green slime.  The accumulated moisture oozes down the slime formation, leaving miscolored droplets underfoot.  The occasional unseen figures journeying in the darkness cause a strange crunching sound as they pass.

Large and small boulders, arranged in a haphazard pile and covered in a sickly orange-green slime, stand out along the edge of tenacious foliage that struggles for dominion over the area.  A stagnant pool sits beneath, its accumulated moisture oozing down the slime formation and leaving discolored droplets in its wake.  A collection of unoccupied snail shells litters the pathway, crunching underfoot as any pass by.

description: The already treacherous walkway becomes moreso as rising steam collects on the outcropping in a low-lying mist.  At points, any hope of viewing solid footing is lost beneath the grey, leaving only a miasma of haze that slithers over the edge and into the air.  The effect is bewildering, breaths of wind stirring spectral fingers in the air as if at any moment they could reach out and snatch away the ground underfoot.

title: [Caligos Isle, Northern Passage]
description: Lying along the edge of the plateau is the spine of some enormous sea creature, its monstrous ribcage resting on the debris-strewn path like an eerie ossified arcade.  The bones gleam a ghostly white in the moonlight, a faint echo of the life they once held.

title: [Caligos Isle, Descent]
description: Departing from the plateau above, a twisting and twining path descends towards a tangle of thick, new-growth foliage comprised of knotted vines and rope-thick creepers.  Bands of mist slip through the area, tumbling like dark clouds and pooling in thick banks towards the vegetation below, making it difficult to see with any certainty what lies within.  A cluster of decaying wood that is riddled with dried-out barnacles darkens the eastern edge and blocks all passage deeper into the jungle.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cavern Entrance]
description: The darkened tunnel opens up into an enormous cavern, the malformed limestone columns casting ominous shadows as their forms flicker against the iron-mounted torches scattered along the area.  Mirror-like pools conceal the true size of the area, flanking an uneven path that curves further down into the depths of the cavern.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cavern Tunnel]
description: Mismatched rows of stalactites drape diagonally along the rock-laden path, the icicle-like formations creating tapered conduits for the droplets of water that mix with the dusty floor below.  A small line of footprints has been imprinted into the muddy puddles, disappearing entirely before the trail ends.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cavern's Maw]
description: More vein-like fissures splay along the limestone walls, the ceiling pierced by disfigured stalactites like sharpened fangs threatening to rip apart a web-covered decline across the dusty floor below.  A dislodged stalactite lays shattered above a yellowed skull of dubious origin, a furry spider weaving an intricate web within its hollow eyesockets.

title: [Caligos Isle, Spider's Delight]
description: The blackened floor is covered in empty hulls of webbing, a variety of carcasses deteriorating into piles of sludge from the hot, muggy air.  The occasional rock tumbles down from high above the caverns, echoing off the narrow walls before being entangled in a thick, complex web.

title: [Caligos Isle, Abandoned Pier]
description: The small rivulets of water leading from the hole join dozens of thin streams in a steep drop-off, the area barely lit by a single torch flickering with gusts of cold wind.  Across the spray-enshrouded divide is a wood-planked pier, its supports slowly swaying as the water beneath it flows into the blackness below.

title: [Caligos Isle, Indigo Pools]
description: Softly glowing light issues from a pool in the center of the cavern, its indigo illumination warring for dominance over that of the shadows cast by stalactites anchored in the ceiling.  Crystalline structures formed of salt deposits line the porous walls of volcanic rock, their surfaces remaining slick from the constant draining of water from above.  A warped wooden bench rests at the front of a short wooden dock with its back to the steep incline that disappears into the darkness.
paths: Obvious exits: southwest, west, northwest, up

title: [Caligos Isle, Wall of Despair]
description: Thin cracks beneath the rocky surface hiss and vibrate, releasing plumes of steam that surround a large sconce-flanked hole, the heavy haze making proper breathing difficult.  The layered walls of rock have been inscribed with illegible drawings, the dark sanguine ink bleeding down into a puddle of moistened dirt.

title: [Caligos Isle, Shadowed Grotto]
description: A ring of dying torches flickers through the grotto, the flames casting elongated shadows over the pale greenish waters.  A crumbling curved stairway cuts alongside the underground pool, the ramp briefly concealed as the torches threaten to be extinguished by the rivulets of liquid dripping from the ceiling.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Blot Alley]
description: Chipped cobblestones scattered along the alley conspire with the street's acclivity, challenging pedestrians to pass through with ankles untwisted.  A dusty pile of crumbled brick and mortar lies beneath a chipped-up section of the eastern brick wall.

title: [Right to Flare Arms, Porch]
description: Beneath an adequate fel roof, thick pine planks form a sturdy square floor raised a single ply from the ground.  Scraps of various woods offer a railing to lean against, opposite a chipped cobblestone archway bookended by a front-lipped sloped maple table and an elevated tinted glass display.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Scrip Shop]
description: Luminescent green moss lines the slick stone walls of this small chamber and provides adequate lighting despite a lack of windows or candles.  Thin pathways between various sized containers and tables impede navigation to a beaded curtain.

title: [Scrip Shop, Upstairs]
description: The tall metal-framed windows enclosing the room have been boarded shut, the iron nails sticking out in irregular angles to create makeshift hooks.  Heavy, hole-ridden sheets of green velvet loosely cover a series of pristine wooden crates, the fabric pooling across the knitted rugs covering the dusty planks.  A pair of driftwood-carved sculptures flank a gilt-painted curio in the far corner, the open doors draped in a fine layer of brittle cobwebs.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Order]
description: Providing egress to both the floor above and the one below, a golden linden spiral staircase dominates the center of this circular landing fashioned of alabaster stones.  Gauzy curtains of translucent white are bound in golden rings to create a cloudy-like halo that encircles a round west-facing window.  Five bright white globes dangle from the ceiling, their dormant interiors points of darkness in the sunlight.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Apex]
description: Rising from a perfect hole in the granite floor, a spiral staircase spills into the room amid a halo of five golden mirrors that reflect the moonlight in all directions.  Alabaster, carnelian, aventurine, onyx, and azurite tiles form half circles upon the floor, their open-ends facing matching half-circle archways that lead towards illuminated balconies.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Chaos]
description: Ebon tiles, speckled with rainbow-hued mica, are fitted amongst oddly shaped onyx slabs to form the floor and ceiling of this compact chamber.  Golden chains descend from the ceiling to support obsidian bowls that are filled with fire, their flickering light creating chaotic patterns upon the reflective walls.  Moonlight invades the space via a round east-facing window and casts its silvery light upon a golden linden spiral staircase that offers passage to the upper and lower chambers.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Foyer]
description: Fine-grained and weathered granite blocks, ranging in size from small and flat rectangles to thick and large squares, form the walls and ceiling of the circular chamber.  Towering archways, five in total, are evenly spaced throughout, their hazy openings glowing with a dim light.  Five teardrop-shaped lanterns dangle from golden chains around a central, spiral staircase that ascends to the floor above.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Planar]
description: Large and small blocks of granite transition from rose to crimson within this small chamber, the gradient hues becoming pale enough to be nearly white in one section, while the opposite section is nearly black.  Star-shaped stained glass lanterns dangle from the ceiling around a golden linden spiral staircase that leads both up and down.  Beneath a southwestern-facing window, a cushioned bench of sanguine and mauve provides a comfortable resting place.

title: [Higher Thinking]
description: The smooth, unevenly spaced driftwood that comprise the walls of this poorly constructed shack give evidence in both sight and smell of ages spent in or near the swelling sea; indeed, bits of sand and dried muck cling desperately to the occasional dent in the wood of several of the logs.  Through gaps in the walls, you hear waves crashing eternally in rhythm with the unabating buzzing of big bugs.  The ground below is formed of a mixture of crushed seashells, sand, and other unidentifable substances.

title: [Just For Kicks]
description: In front of a long wooden counter, faded and threadbare rugs are scattered over a hard-packed dirt floor.
